facts.Equatorial Radius: 2,574.7 km (2nd largest moon in Solar System, larger than Mercury)
facts.Dense Atmosphere: 98.4% N₂, 1.4% CH₄; surface pressure 1.45 atm (50% denser than Earth's)
facts.Hydrocarbon Seas: Kraken Mare (400,000 km²), Ligeia Mare, and Punga Mare of liquid methane/ethane
facts.Hydrological Cycle: Methane clouds, rain, rivers, river deltas, and sand dunes made of organic tholins
facts.Huygens Landing: ESA probe touched down on Titan's frozen pebbled surface on Jan 14, 2005
facts.Future Mission: NASA Dragonfly rotorcraft lander launching to explore Selk Crater
